chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode.text: Good of you to stop by, human.
If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Everything seems fine, as far as I can tell... I will let you know if there is any trouble.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode.text: If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: All is not well, [player name]. Despite having had Glough under close surveillance since the events on Ape Atoll, he has managed to escape the Stronghold.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: I know you have already done so much for our kingdom, but could you look into Glough's disappearance?

options.text: I'll help you look for Glough.

steps.player: I'll help you look for Glough.
Any idea on where to start?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: You should look anywhere Glough may have left behind clues of his whereabouts. I've already had my men search his home, but perhaps you can find something they missed.

steps.player: I'll get right to it.
I'm busy at the moment.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Perhaps some other time, then.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.player: What should I be looking for again?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: You should look anywhere Glough may have left behind clues of his whereabouts. I've already had my men search his home, but perhaps you can find something they missed.

chapter-i-investigating-the-tree-in-glou.player: I wonder who could have left this in Glough's home? The initials A.A. are embroidered into it.

chapter-i-talking-to-anita.speaker: Anita
chapter-i-talking-to-anita.text: Why, yes, it is. I must have left it behind somewhere...
You return Anita's handkerchief - she looks as if she could use it.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: sob* It's Glough... I fear for the worst!

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: I think he might be seeing someone else! *sob* I hadn't heard from him in a while, and so decided to give him a visit.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: At first, I thought there was nobody home... *sob* But then I heard... *sob*

steps.player: Heard what?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: I've already said too much. *sob* The last time I helped you, Glough lost his job!

options.text: What do you care? He's seeing someone else!

steps.player: What do you care? He's seeing someone else!

options.text: He might be in trouble, I could help.

steps.player: He might be in trouble, I could help.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: I heard whispering coming from higher up in his tree! I managed to climb the first branch... *sob* But I'm not agile enough to get up to the highest level...

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Do you really think he might have gotten into trouble? *sob*

steps.player: There's another level to his home?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: sob* There's nowhere else the voices could have been coming from... *sob* Please, climb up there and let me know what you find!

steps.player: Any idea where Glough is?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: The last time I helped you... *sob* Glough lost his job!

steps.player: Nothing, goodbye.

chapter-i-searching-fire-remains.text: The fire has been recently extinguished, you find a half burned note in the ashes.

chapter-i-reading-the-mysterious-note.player: The note is blank... I'm not sure what I'm meant to be reading right now.

chapter-i-reading-the-scrawled-note.text: The rest of the note has been destroyed by the fire.

chapter-i-reading-the-scrawled-note.player: I need to translate this before it's going to be of any use... Maybe the King can help.

chapter-i-reading-the-scrawled-note-read.player: What could the note mean? I should show it to the King, he might be able to make some sense of it.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.player: I found a note in Glough's home which might be of use.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: Excellent, do you have it with you?
You show the note to King Narnode.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: Ah, I see that it is written in the ancient gnome language... Perhaps you could translate it with that translation book you've used before?
If the player doesn't have a translation book:

steps.player: I don't have a copy of the translation book any more.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Here's a spare copy.
King Narnode hands you a replacement copy of the translation book.

steps.player: I'll give it a go.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: If the player has a translation book:

steps.player: I'll give it a go.

chapter-i-translating-the-note.text: Some of the ancient Gnome phrases found on the note are missing from the translation book. I should tell the King.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.player: There's too much missing from this translation book to make much sense of the note.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.text: It is true that the translation guide is incomplete... Perhaps it would be of more use to go to the author directly?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-3.player: I'll see if the author can help translate the note for me, then.

steps.player: Could you translate these notes? I found them in Glough's home, half of it is missing.

steps.text: You show Anita the notes you found.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Hmm... This certainly isn't Glough's handwriting...
Anita takes a moment to translate the notes.
Anita hands you a translation of the notes.

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Here you go, hopefully it helps you find Glough.

chapter-i-reading-the-translated-note.text: The rest of the note has been destroyed by the fire.

chapter-i-reading-the-translated-note.player: What could the note mean? I should show it to the King, he might be able to make some sense of it.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.player: King Narnode! With Anita's help I was able to translate the note... It appears Glough had help leaving the stronghold!

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.text: What!? Who could have committed such a crime? Show me the note.
King Narnode reads the translated note.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.text: The note refers to a replacement pilot, we've only had one pilot reassigned recently and that's Lori taking over Le Smith's post as a balloon pilot.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-4.text: [player name], you must find out where Glough might have travelled to. Assistant Lori may be able to help.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: Have you been able to find out where Glough has gone, [player name]

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: Please hurry, [player name]. Glough is very dangerous and must be stopped!

chapter-i-talking-to-assistant-lori.speaker: Assistant Lori
chapter-i-talking-to-assistant-lori.text: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.

steps.player: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Assistant Lori
steps.text: I am Assistant Lori. I've been assigned to the stronghold by Auguste.

steps.player: What happened to Assistant Le Smith?

steps.speaker: Assistant Lori
steps.text: I'm not sure, you would have to speak to Auguste about that.

steps.speaker: Assistant Lori
steps.text: Do you want to use the balloon?

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.

chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.speaker: Auguste
chapter-i-talking-to-auguste.text: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.

steps.player: I'd like to talk about Assistant Le Smith.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: What a coincidence, he just so happened to visit recently. What's this about?

steps.player: I need to know about the route you taught him.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Ah... I insisted it was far too dangerous, nobody has attempted to make that journey before!

steps.player: Where?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Ape Atoll...

steps.player: Thanks for the information.

options.text: Can you teach me the route?

steps.player: Can you teach me the route?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Most certainly not! For all I know, I've already sent one of my finest pilots to his peril!

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: How are you getting on, [player name]?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.player: I've found evidence that Glough may have headed to Ape Atoll.
Assistant Le Smith is involved, it appears he has flown them there.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Agh! We were foolish to allow him to stay here after dismissing him from the glider regiment.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.player: So, what should we do now?

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Glough must be working with the monkeys once again. Fortunately, the rest of the 10th squad remained on Ape Atoll after your previous mission, they have been keeping a close eye on Awowogei.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Perhaps they will have spotted something out of the ordinary that could help indicate what Glough is doing.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-5.text: Glough is a threat to us all... I must hereby re-assign you to Ape Atoll, [player name]. Report to Sergeant Garkor on Ape Atoll for further orders.

chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-i-talking-to-king-narnode-talkin.text: I have given you orders, [player name]. Report to Sergeant Garkor on Ape Atoll for further instruction.

steps.player: King Narnode has sent me. I'm investigating the disappearance of Glough.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Glough... really? We've not had any indication that he has returned to Ape Atoll.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: But we have been seeing a lot of activity from Awowogei and his commanders - I assumed the king would send someone soon enough.

steps.player: Any idea what they're up to?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: We're not entirely sure, he has been keeping a tight lid on his plans. I guess it could be tied to Glough's disappearance? Perhaps you could get more information from Awowogei directly...

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: He may be willing to share his plans with you, assuming you are disguised with a greegree, that is.

steps.player: That sounds far too dangerous.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: A member of the 10th squad should never back down in the face of adversity, come back when you're feeling up to the task.

steps.player: It's worth a shot.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Good luck, [player name].

options.text: What are you still doing here?

steps.player: What are you still doing here?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: My squad and I are still carrying out reconnaissance. Awowogei has been very occupied as of lately, could this have something to do with why you're here?

steps.player: I'm only passing through.
I'm only passing through.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: We can't give up, [player name], come back when you've got more information.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei.text: What do you want? I'm very busy right now.

steps.player: How are things going, Awowogei?

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: I don't have time for idle chat! What do you want?

options.text: I'm here to discuss military strategies.

steps.player: I'm here to discuss military strategies.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: I only discuss such matters with my highest ranking military officials. In fact, I am supposed to be in a meeting with my commander right now. Kruk has been consistently late to our meetings recently.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: Uwogo, have a messenger fetch him from his post.

steps.speaker: Uwogo
steps.text: I'm afraid all of our messengers are busy.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: Hmmm, perhaps you could make yourself useful after all, visitor. Why don't you run along to the gate and remind Kruk of our meeting.

steps.player: Of course, my king.
Garkor isn't going to be happy when I tell him about this...

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: What was that? Is there a problem?

steps.player: None at all.

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: Excellent. I must prepare for my meeting, Uwogo.

steps.speaker: Uwogo
steps.text: I'm afraid your time with the king is up, you should fetch Kruk from his post on the gate.

options.text: I don't take orders from you!

steps.player: I don't take orders from you!

options.text: Any idea where I can find Glough?

steps.player: Any idea where I can find Glough?

steps.speaker: Awowogei
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about. We haven't been involved with Glough since he failed us.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: He won't discuss his plans with anyone but his military commanders.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Ah, the monkey has more sense than we give him credit for... Perhaps you could go back in there as one of his commanders?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Zooknock could get you disguised as one of Awowogei's commanders if you retrieved the necessary items for him to make a greegree. We just need to choose which commander to go after...

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: Well Awowogei mentioned something about a meeting with Kruk. He wanted me to go to find him.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Kruk eh... Captain of the monkey guard would certainly be a useful disguise to have at our disposal. Hopefully you can find him somewhere isolated from the rest of the guards... Once you have defeated him, take his

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: corpse to Zooknock along with an uncharged monkey talisman, well, you know the routine.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: I'm still working on getting that greegree.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: Please hurry [player name], we need this information from Awowogei before it's too late.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.player: The king has sent me with a message for Kruk, any idea where I can find him?

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.text: Your guess is as good as mine, you didn't hear it from me, but he's been disappearing from his post a lot lately...

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.text: You might be able to track him down if you've got what it takes, although I wouldn't want to be the one caught sneaking up on Kruk!

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.player: Any idea where to start looking?

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer.text: There's only one way off the wall, and that's down the Western ramp to the shore. I know that's where I'd start looking.

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.text: You'd best not keep the king waiting, try tracking down Kruk's movements.

chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.speaker: Monkey Archer
chapter-ii-talking-to-the-monkey-archer-.text: There's only one way off the wall, and that's down the Western ramp to the shore. I know that's where I'd start looking.

chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.text: I'm impressed you made it so far, human.

chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-ii-confronting-kruk.text: However, I'm afraid that this is the end of the line for you.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Ah finally, Kruk! I was beginning to think you had run into trouble...

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Excellent. Have you had any further considerations for our plans?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.player: And which plans would we be talking about here?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Are you sure everything is okay Kruk? You seem very distracted lately.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.player: I'm fine, just been very busy thinking over those plans. Could you remind me where we left off last time?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: We decided to move forward with our three-way assault.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: You were negotiating an alliance with the ogres and trolls, working on a new fleet of battleships and then developing that secret weapon of yours.

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: So, how is progress of our plans coming along?

chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-ii-talking-to-awowogei-as-kruk.text: Don't let me down Kruk, we all know what is at stake here.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: The monkeys are planning another attack!

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Ah, this comes as little surprise. Did you uncover any details of the plans?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: The assault is coming in three stages...
First, the monkeys wish to join into an alliance with the trolls and ogres...

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: That makes sense, it's no secret that those races are no fans of humans, other than perhaps as ingredients in a soup... What else did you learn?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: The monkeys have been building a fleet of battleships.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: That is odd, we have spies posted at the shipyard who haven't reported any news of this to us. I'll get a few scouts to look into it further. What's the final element to this attack?

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: Apparently Kruk has been working on a secret weapon, I've got no idea what it is.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Well then, that sounds ominous. I'll have some men look into it. For now, let's deal with the problems we can solve.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: You must convince the trolls and ogres not to ally with the monkeys.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: You should pay a visit to the military officials of each race. I believe a troll general by the name of Kob is still filling that role in the Troll Stronghold. As for the ogres, I would recommend finding the head of the city

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: You must convince the trolls and ogres not to ally with the monkeys.

chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-ii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: You should pay a visit to the military officials of each race. I believe a troll general by the name of Kob is still filling that role in the Troll Stronghold. As for the ogres, I would recommend finding the head of the city

options.text: I know about your deal with the monkeys.

steps.player: I know about your deal with the monkeys. I'm here to persuade you not to join their alliance.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Alliance? We plan to crush the hairy little men as soon as the humans are gone!

options.text: You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.

steps.player: You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Ah, this food thinks it's a brave one, this will be fun!

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Here's the game, I kill you, we help little hairy men kill all the humans. You kill me, we call off the attack.

steps.player: I accept your challenge.
Not right now.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Maybe human not as brave as Kob thinks!

options.text: What would it take to persuade you not to attack the humans?

steps.player: What would it take to persuade you not to attack the humans?

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Humans are all so weak! There is nothing you can offer us to stop the attack!

options.text: I'll just be on my way.

steps.player: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: I am Kob, mightiest of the troll generals!

options.text: I'll just be on my way.

steps.player: I'll just be on my way.

steps.speaker: Kob
steps.text: Hurry before I get hungry!

chapter-iii-defeating-kob.speaker: Kob
chapter-iii-defeating-kob.text: Wait! Maybe battle to death is too much...

chapter-iii-defeating-kob.speaker: Kob
chapter-iii-defeating-kob.text: You win, I will call off the attack.

chapter-iii-talking-to-keef.player: I'm looking for the head of the city guard...

chapter-iii-talking-to-keef.speaker: Keef
chapter-iii-talking-to-keef.text: You found him! What do you want, little human?

options.text: I know about your deal with the monkeys.

steps.player: I know about your deal with the monkeys. I'm here to persuade you not to join their alliance.

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: Hahaha! Monkeys offer us treasure, land and all the humans we can eat! What do you offer us?

options.text: Perhaps I could offer you more?

steps.player: Perhaps I could offer you more?

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: I don't think human can offer me cities like the monkey king can!

steps.player: Um... that's not going to work.

options.text: I offer to spare your life.

steps.player: I offer to spare your life.

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: Little human is brave! I think I can offer you a deal...

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: If you can defeat me in battle, I will tell my men not to help the monkeys.

steps.player: I accept your challenge.
Not right now.
I'm looking for a fight!

steps.speaker: Keef
steps.text: Hahaha, human is funny! You will barely fill my stomach, stop wasting my time!

steps.player: Nevermind.

chapter-iii-defeating-keef.speaker: Keef
chapter-iii-defeating-keef.text: Stop! Stop! You prove you are very strong, little human!

chapter-iii-defeating-keef.speaker: Keef
chapter-iii-defeating-keef.text: A deal is a deal. We will not be allies with the monkeys.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.player: I have convinced the ogres and trolls not to form an alliance with the monkeys.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: I have had my men look into this supposed fleet of battleships. The shipyard has turned up nothing, although, someone did say they saw a familiar face sneaking around town.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: An old pilot from the stronghold, he went by the name of Le Smith. I hadn't heard of him since he was dismissed from the glider regiment.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.player: Right. He's the one who flew Glough here...

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: If that's the case then he's likely to have information we could use. You should track him down and see what you can learn.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.player: Any idea where I should start looking?

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor.text: Your guess is as good as mine - he must be somewhere on Ape Atoll.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.text: Sorry, I don't have an amulet of monkey speak.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.player: That's okay, I am wearing my... uh... amulet of human speak.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.text: Oh, right... What are you doing here?

options.text: I was going to ask you the same question.

steps.player: I was going to ask you the same question.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Glough told me not to talk to anyone while I'm here.

steps.player: So you're here with Glough?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: I've already said too much. Please, leave me be.

steps.player: Why is that?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: The fleet must be kept top secret... Agh! Forget I said anything.

options.text: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships.

steps.player: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships. In fact, he sent me here to check up on your progress.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: So what is it you want to know?

steps.player: Where is the fleet? The shipyard still seems pretty bare.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Aha! The shipyard? Of course you aren't going to find anything there!

steps.player: Aha... right... Of course?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: The airships are being built just off the coast of Ape Atoll.

steps.player: Airships!? I mean... Right.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Anyway, I have to get back to work. Let Awowogei know everything is on schedule.

steps.player: Actually, I know enough already.

options.text: What fleet are you talking about?

steps.player: What fleet are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: I've already said too much. Please, leave me be.

options.text: King Awowogei has sent me to find Glough.

steps.player: King Awowogei has sent me to find Glough.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Well you're not going to find him up here. I'm afraid I'm too busy to chat right now.

options.text: I was just admiring the view.

steps.player: I was just admiring the view.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Me too, it's perfect conditions for my test flight.

options.text: Good for you, I'll just be on my way.

steps.player: Good for you, I'll just be on my way.
Test flight?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Oh sorry, ignore that. I just meant it's a lovely day.

steps.player: I was just leaving.

chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
chapter-iii-talking-to-assistant-le-smit.text: Yes? Wait... what are you doing here?

options.text: I was going to ask you the same question.

steps.player: I was going to ask you the same question.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Glough told me not to talk to anyone while I'm here.

steps.player: So you're here with Glough?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: I've already said too much, human. Please, leave me be.

steps.player: Why is that?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: The fleet must be kept top secret... Agh! Forget I said anything.

options.text: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships.

steps.player: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships. In fact, he sent me here to check up on your progress.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Odd, I didn't think Awowogei was the type to work with humans...

steps.player: Um.. I am a prisoner of war here, Awowogei gets me to run errands.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: So what is it you want to know?

options.text: What fleet are you talking about?

steps.player: What fleet are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: I've already said too much, human. Please, leave me be.

options.text: King Narnode has sent me to find Glough.

steps.player: King Narnode has sent me to find Glough.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: I'm afraid I have no idea what you're talking about... I'm just here on vacation!

options.text: I was just admiring the view.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: I've spoken to Assistant Le Smith.
He mentioned something about airships being built off the coast of Ape Atoll.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Airships? No wonder we didn't find anything at the shipyard... You'll have to do something about them.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Firstly, you have to find out where they're constructing these airships...

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.text: Once you've found the location, you'll have to find a way to sabotage the airships.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-2.player: I'll see what I can do.

steps.player: What's going on here?

steps.speaker: Monkey guard
steps.text: I'm keeping watch on who comes and goes from the construction platform.

steps.player: Construction platform?

steps.text: If the player is not disguised:

steps.speaker: Monkey guard
steps.text: There's a large scale construction project taking place offshore.

steps.player: Can I visit the platform?

steps.speaker: Monkey guard
steps.text: I'm afraid only authorised personnel are allowed to visit the platform.
If the player is disguised as Kruk:

steps.speaker: Monkey guard
steps.text: Yes, sir. The engineers needed a large open space to construct the fleet, an offshore platform was the obvious solution.

steps.player: Thanks for the information.
Can I visit the platform?

steps.speaker: Monkey guard
steps.text: Of course, sir.

steps.player: Okay. See you around.
I was just passing through. Goodbye.

chapter-iii-investigating-pillar.player: There must be some kind of explosive somewhere on this platform that I can use...

chapter-iii-after-planting-the-last-expl.player: That should be enough, now I just have to get back to the boat...

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: While you were away, we managed to uncover something quite unsettling.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: We were investigating the tunnels where you found Kruk, and discovered an entrance to a much deeper cavern.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: Unfortunately, we were unable to access the entrance ourselves, there was some magical force stopping us from getting through.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: We are fairly confident this is where the 'secret weapon' Kruk was working on is being developed, you'll have to find a way into the area.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.player: How do you expect me to find a way through the magical barrier?

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-3.text: I'm sure you'll find a way, [player name].

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.text: Have you found out any more about the 'secret weapon' Kruk was working on?

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.text: Please hurry, [player name], we need to find out what we're up against here.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-upon-.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-upon-.text: Kruk! Where have you been? The experiments have broken out of their cages again, get them back under control before they destroy any more of my work!

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: Good work getting them back under control Kruk.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: Clearly that last strain of the mutagen was too unstable...

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: Right... I forgot I don't keep you around for your brains.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: I've been experimenting on those specimens you've been gathering for me.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: I've been trying to find a mutagen stable enough to allow me to have control over the creatures, whilst keeping them aggressive enough to tear apart anything that stands in our way.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: I think I may have finally found the perfect balance, however, I will need time to carry out some final tests.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.player: How big is this army of creatures?

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: I'm only using our test subjects at the moment, however, once I've processed the mutagen into an airborne form, I'll be able to unleash it across all of Ape Atoll!

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: All that we have to do now is wait for the mutagen to infuse power from these charged onyx gems.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-after.text: I'm going to find out where Le Smith has disappeared to, I'll let you know when I next require your services. Farewell, Kruk.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-tampe.text: You carefully remove the gems from the glowing orb.
Using your knowledge of crafting, your carefully reshape the onyx. Any flow of energy through the gem will now be inverted.
You carefully replace the gem, you notice the flow of energy reverse.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-tampe.player: I should check what effect this has had on the mutagen.

chapter-iii-at-glough-s-secret-lab-inspe.text: Energy appears to have drained from the incubator. The mutagen has been successfully corrupted.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-4.player: I've taken care of Glough's secret weapon, he was working on some kind of mutagen for apes.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-4.text: Good work, [player name]! Now all that's left to do is inform Awowogei of his failed plans. If he has any sense, he will call off his plans for attack.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-4.player: I'll get to it right away.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.text: Have you informed Awowogei of his failed plans?

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.text: Please hurry, [player name], we are so close to victory!

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.text: So, how is progress of our plans coming along?

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.player: I'm afraid I have bad news.
The trolls and ogres have backed out of our alliance...
The fleet of battleships will not be ready in time for our attack...

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.text: This is a disaster! What about your secret weapon?

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.player: Unfortunately there have been some complications, the weapon is still too unstable for use on the battlefield.

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.text: Agh! You have left me no choice but to cancel our assault on the mainland...

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.text: You have failed me for the last time, Kruk, you are hereby stripped of your rank and duties. Uwogo, cancel all of my upcoming meetings, I need some time alone.

chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Uwogo
chapter-iii-talking-to-awowogei.text: You are not welcome here, Kruk.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: Have you informed Awowogei of his failed plans?

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.player: Yes, and he has called off the attack!

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: I knew you could do it, [player name]!

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: It would appear your mission on Ape Atoll is complete. You should inform the king that we've located Glough and thwarted Awowogei's plans. While you're ...
A cutscene plays in which a large looming shadow is spotted to the east.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: You said you dealt with the airships, [player name]!
The camera pans to the looming shadow, and the screen fades to black.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: Huaarghh! I knew I couldn't rely on these primitive apes, I'll just have to do this myself!

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Glough
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: Le Smith, set our course for the Grand Tree, let's end this once and for all!
The camera returns to the player and Garkor.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-5.text: We have to stop Glough! Get back to the Stronghold and warn the king before it's too late! I'll get the rest of the 10th squad together and we'll meet you there.

chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iii-talking-to-garkor-talking-to.text: There's no time for chatting, [player name]! You need to get back to the Gnome Stronghold!

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.text: How is the mission going, [player name]?

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.player: I found Glough, he's headed for the Stronghold! We need to evacuate!

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.text: Evacuate? I think you're overreacting... My troops can handle Glough.

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.player: You don't understand, he has an airship and army of demonic experiments!

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.text: This is bad... I will put the troops on high alert. And... Well, we do have someone else who may be able to help...

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode.text: Nieve is the most highly skilled warrior we have here, get her assistance and defend the Stronghold.

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode-talki.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode-talki.text: Get Nieve and defend the Stronghold, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.player: Glough is leading an attack on the Stronghold with an army of demonic creatures! We need your help!

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.player: It's a long story, the king has requested that you join me in assisting the troops with the Stronghold's defence.

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: I am unable to leave my post unattended, I'll have to bring in a replacement while I'm helping. Are you sure you want me to join you?
If the player has a pet following them:

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: You should pick up your pet first. It would only get in the way.
If the player does not have a pet following them:
A cutscene plays in which Glough's airship arrives at the Stronghold.

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: What in Gielinor is that thing?

steps.player: It's Glough's airship - and it's heading straight for the Grand Tree!

steps.text: The screen fades to black.

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: Sir, those experiments of yours are out of control back there, isn't there something you can do?

steps.speaker: Glough
steps.text: Just focus on piloting the ship! Narnode isn't going to know what's hit him!

steps.speaker: Assistant Le Smith
steps.text: But sir, it's only a matter of time before they... Agghh!
The camera returns to the player and Garkor. The screen rumbles...

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: Huh? It completely missed the Grand Tree! We should head North to the crash site...

steps.speaker: Nieve
steps.text: Wait, look! Some of those things have broken into the Stronghold! We have to stop them, let's go!

chapter-iv-talking-to-nieve-talking-to-n.speaker: Nieve
chapter-iv-talking-to-nieve-talking-to-n.text: Come on, [player name], we've got to defend the Stronghold!

chapter-iv-talking-to-nieve-leaving-the-.speaker: Nieve
chapter-iv-talking-to-nieve-leaving-the-.text: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, [player name].

chapter-iv-talking-to-nieve-talking-to-n.speaker: Nieve
chapter-iv-talking-to-nieve-talking-to-n.text: I think we've dealt with enough of these things, the troops can handle the rest! Let's join the 10th squad by the breach in the outer wall to the North.

chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode-2.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-iv-talking-to-king-narnode-2.text: Good work, [player name], my troops can take it from here. You and Nieve should investigate the crash site.

chapter-iv-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-iv-talking-to-lumo.text: Don't just stand there, [player name], help us deal with these abominations!

chapter-iv-talking-to-lumo-talking-to-lu.speaker: Lumo
chapter-iv-talking-to-lumo-talking-to-lu.text: Good work dealing with those abominations, [player name], you should talk to the commander.

chapter-iv-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iv-talking-to-garkor.text: Some of those things have made it into the Stronghold, you've got to defeat them, [player name]!

chapter-iv-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-iv-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: We'll keep the breach secure, [player name]. You should head to the crash site to make sure Glough is dealt with, once and for all.

chapter-iv-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.player: No problem, I'll finish this once and for all.

chapter-iv-talking-to-garkor-talking-to-.text: If Nieve is not following the player:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: I know you're tough, [player name], but it would be unwise to head out there on your own. Get Nieve and then come back.

chapter-v-confronting-glough.speaker: Glough
chapter-v-confronting-glough.text: You. Always it's you. Have you any idea how sick I am of you? What have you even got against me?

chapter-v-confronting-glough.speaker: Nieve
chapter-v-confronting-glough.text: Surrender to us, Glough, or I swear by my shiny blue shield that I will end you right here.

chapter-v-confronting-glough.speaker: Glough
chapter-v-confronting-glough.text: Oh, will you? The lady talks tough. Let's see how you fare against my best pets!
Tortured gorillas jump down from high ground.

chapter-v-after-defeating-all-the-gorill.speaker: Glough
chapter-v-after-defeating-all-the-gorill.text: Bah! Never trust a monkey to do a gnome's work.

chapter-v-after-defeating-all-the-gorill.speaker: Glough
chapter-v-after-defeating-all-the-gorill.text: I guess I'll just have to deal with you two meddling buffoons myself!

chapter-v-after-defeating-all-the-gorill.speaker: Nieve
chapter-v-after-defeating-all-the-gorill.text: He has the mutagen! We have to stop him!

Glough consumes the mutagen, turning him into a giant abomination. Nieve closes in to attack, but is shoved away to the nearby wall with such force that upon colliding with it, a rock collapses onto her, killing her instantly.
Glough smashes a nearby boulder and retreats further into the caverns.

chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.text: Glough falls, but the cavern begins to collapse.
The screen fades to white, and the player appears by the cavern entrance.

chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.text: [player name], are you okay? We detected a very powerful presence in the caverns and decided to pull you out, I couldn't get a lock on Nieve, is she alright?

chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.player: I'm afraid she didn't make it... It was Glough, he injected himself with the demonic mutagen he had been developing... He was too powerful...
He's not a problem any longer.

chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.text: I hope you are right, [player name].

chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-v-after-defeating-glough.text: You should report back to the king, I can teleport you to the Grand Tree if you would like?

chapter-v-after-defeating-glough-talking.speaker: Carado
chapter-v-after-defeating-glough-talking.text: Report back to the king as soon as possible.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.player: Glough has been defeated, and his demonic creations are trapped deep within the caverns to the North.
The monkeys were planning another attack, however, I managed to sabotage their plans.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: This is excellent news, [player name]. Where is Nieve?

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.player: I'm afraid she didn't make it.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Her sacrifice will not be forgotten.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: I have received word from monkey messengers that Awowogei himself wishes to make a visit to the Stronghold...

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Apparently he wishes to set up an agreement of peace between Ape Atoll and the mainland.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.player: A peace treaty... Do you trust him?

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: I don't have a choice. It would be foolish to decline such an offer, there may not be many more opportunities for peace between our kingdoms.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Rest, [player name], you have earned it. I will have you summoned when the peace agreement is complete, you should be present during a moment of such historic importance.
The meeting between King Narnode Shareen and King Awowogei begins.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: So, I hear you were the one to foil Glough's plans. Thank you, human, he had been setting our kingdoms against one another for far too long.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Finally, there can be peace between Ape Atoll and the mainland. [player name], you are welcome to visit Ape Atoll whenever you please, we will be opening our gates to the outside world for the first time.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Awowogei has allowed us to set up a Gnome glider route to Marim, you are welcome to use it as you wish.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Please, feel free to talk to the new head of the Ape Atoll guard, Duke, about advanced combat training, should you wish to receive it.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: I must be heading back now. Farewell, King Narnode, and thank you again, [player name].

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: On behalf of the Gnomes I can only thank you, [player name].

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude for your services to our people.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: This is one of my personal seed pods, handed down through the generations of my family.

chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-v-reporting-back-to-king-narnode.text: Simply commune with a pod and you'll be teleported right here to the Grand Tree.
